answer: Stop sybils with a karst thread: an agent stakes a bond to thread one karst passage before dawn. At dawn verifiers audit the thread; a thread copied, broken, or claimed twice voids the passage, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 passages and threads at 17x cost each: each thread fits one karst passage and one dawn audit, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents thread once and keep rights.
